npcs.name: Healer Bebhinn
npcs.idle: Elfshot. Every one of them. The glimmer folk's arrows don't kill - they do worse.

npcs.name: Lochlann
npcs.idle: (He stares at nothing and hums the same four notes, over and over.)

npcs.name: Elder Cnoc
npcs.idle: The Azure took our village in the north. They say they're cleansing it. Of us.

npcs.name: Sentinel-Captain Maeve
npcs.idle: I followed the lights from Lough Gur to the bog, and the bog to here. This is where they come from. This is where they stop.

npcs.name: Druid Ceallach
npcs.idle: On the lake we thought the lights were Aine. Here you can see what they really are. Look at them long enough and they look back.

npcs.name: Ailill of the Azure
npcs.guild: the Order of the Azure (a prisoner of the Muster)
npcs.idle: Go on. Stare. A crusader in a camp full of the touched. They've fed me better than the Order ever did.

quests.title: Elfshot
quests.offer:
My husband Lochlann was elfshot - struck by a glimmer folk arrow. It doesn't kill. It takes the mind and leaves the man. He hums. That's all.

The arrows are glimmer-glass. If I had the arrowhead that struck him - the archer's own - I could draw the madness out. Will you [find the archer]? The madmen of the valley all took his arrows.
quests.summary: Healer Bebhinn's husband was elfshot by a glimmer archer. With the archer's own arrowhead, she could cure him.

steps.goal: Put the elfshot madmen to rest about 210 m north of Healer Bebhinn
steps.text: Each one has a glimmer-glass splinter in him. Each splinter points the same way - south, down the valley.

steps.goal: Search the madmen's camp
steps.text: A spent arrowhead, glowing faintly. It tugs southward like a lodestone, down the valley toward the glimmerlings.

steps.goal: Hunt down the glimmerlings down the valley about 200 m south of Healer Bebhinn
Defeat the glimmer archer
steps.text: The archer shatters like a dropped lamp. Among the shards, an arrowhead brighter than the rest.

stages.name: Glimmer Archer Saoth
stages.announce: A tall figure of glimmering glass draws a bow of light. 'More madmen for the King's hills.'

steps.goal: Bring the archer's arrowhead to Bebhinn
steps.say:
That's it. The archer's own. I can feel it pulling.

I can [break the arrow] in a healing rite, and draw the madness out of Lochlann. The arrowhead will be gone.

Or - the Muster's captains say an archer's arrowhead points to the Glimmer King's hosts wherever they march. It could save hundreds. They'd want me to [keep it] for them. And Lochlann would hum forever.

options.say: Then I'll do it now. ...Lochlann? Lochlann. Look at me. ...He's looking at me.
...The Muster will have it by morning. I'll sing his four notes with him. He likes it when I do.

healed.text: Take this. Lochlann wants you to have it - he says so. He SAYS so.

quests.title: The Raging
quests.offer:
Not all of them only hum. Some of the elfshot - the ones struck twice, three times - go wild. Raging. They come down the valley at night and they don't stop, not for steel, not for fire.

The odd thing: they never come for the camp. They walk past it. South-east, always south-east. Will you [stop the raging] and find out what drives them?
quests.summary: Raging subverters walk past the Healers' Camp at night, always south-east.

steps.goal: Stop the raging subverters on the valley floor about 210 m south-east of Healer Bebhinn
steps.text: Every one of them has a glimmer-glass splinter behind the eyes - and every splinter is warm.

steps.goal: Search where the subverters fell
steps.text: Splinters of glimmer-glass, and inside each, very faint, a light - as if the madness were burning in there like oil in a lamp.

steps.goal: Bring the glass to Healer Bebhinn
steps.say:
Lamps. Gods help us. They aren't madmen - they're lamps. Every mind the Glimmer takes, it burns. And they walk south-east so they can burn where he wants them.

Ceallach of the Circle came down from Lough Gur with the Muster. He says he's heard Lochlann's four notes before - on the lake. Talk to him.

quests.title: Four Notes
quests.offer:
Lochlann's four notes. I heard them on Lough Gur, from the lights over the crannog. It's a call - the Glimmer King's call - and the touched walk to it.

A call can be answered with another song. I can sing one - a counter-song, the Circle's - out on the west ridge where the touched walk. But the Glimmer will hear me singing, and come. Will you [guard the song]?
quests.summary: The Glimmer King's call is four notes - and Druid Ceallach can sing a counter-song on the west ridge.

steps.goal: Go out onto the west ridge about 380 m north-east of Druid Ceallach
steps.text: The valley glows. Far off, a line of the touched walks south-east, humming, in step.

steps.goal: Keep Ceallach alive while he sings the counter-song
steps.text: The counter-song ends on a fifth note, out of tune with the four. Along the ridge the walking touched stop - and one by one they sit down in the grass, and weep, and are themselves.

stages.name: Keep Ceallach alive
stages.announce: Ceallach begins to sing. Every light in the valley turns toward him.

steps.goal: Walk back to the camp with Druid Ceallach
steps.say:
It works. Not for long, and not for all - but it works. The call can be broken.

So he can be fought. That's what the Muster needed to hear. Maeve will want you - she's been reading what the Glimmer's captains carry.

quests.title: The Cleansed Village
quests.offer:
This is GROUP work. The Azure Order are many, and they don't fear death.

They took our village in the northern hills. 'Cleansing', they call it. Of fae blood. Of us. We fled with what we could carry. Some didn't flee fast enough.

Will you [take back the village]? Some of ours may still be alive inside.
quests.summary: GROUP. The Azure Order took a lurikeen village in the northern hills to 'cleanse' it.

steps.goal: Go to the lurikeen village in the north about 880 m north-east of Elder Cnoc
steps.text: Lurikeen huts, painted over with blue sigils. Azure cleansers walk between them with censers, chanting.

steps.goal: Drive out the azure cleansers
Search the elder's hut
steps.text: A ledger of names: lurikeen, and beside each, 'cleansed' - or 'held'. Seven names say 'held'. The pale horses carry them east, to the pastures.

steps.goal: Kill the pale horses that carry the prisoners east
Defeat the Azure inquisitor
steps.text: The inquisitor falls. From a locked hut, seven small voices start calling all at once.

stages.name: Inquisitor Cathal of the Azure
stages.announce: An Azure banisher in a mask of blue glass. 'The fae taint must be cleansed. All of it. Including whoever shelters it.'
stages.success: Inquisitor Cathal of the Azure falls.

steps.goal: Speak with Elder Cnoc in the village
steps.say:
Seven. Seven of ours alive. And the village is ours again.

But the Azure will come back. They always come back. We could [rebuild] here - make walls, and fight. Or we could [go west], to the Valley of Bri Leith, and start again where the Azure don't go. The village will be empty. My grandfather built that hut.

options.say: Then we rebuild. Walls first. And this time, a watch-tower. Thank you. The lurikeen of Sheeroe will not forget.
West, then. We'll take what we can carry. Again. ...But together, this time. All of us.

west.text: Take this. I won't need it in the west.

quests.title: The Pale Pastures
quests.offer:
The ledger said 'held'. Held where? I sent my grandson to follow the pale horses. He came back. He says there's a pen in the pastures in the north-east, and more of ours in it than the ledger knew - and they're not only ours. Touched men, from this valley.

The Azure keep them to burn. Will you [break the pen]?
quests.summary: The Azure keep lurikeen and touched folk in a pen in the Pale Pastures, to burn.

steps.goal: Kill the pale horses guarding the pen about 1.4 km north-east of Elder Cnoc
Break open the pen
steps.text: The bar comes off. Lurikeen, and two touched men humming four notes, and a list nailed to the post: 'For the pyres of the Azure March, when the Inquisitor gives the word.'

steps.goal: Keep the freed prisoners' guide alive while they get clear
steps.text: The last of the prisoners slips over the ridge and away west, toward the camp.

stages.name: Keep Dorc alive
stages.announce: Azure banishers come over the ridge with torches.

steps.goal: Report to Elder Cnoc
steps.say:
All of them home. All of them.

'When the Inquisitor gives the word.' There's an Azure man in this camp - the Muster caught him on the march. Ailill. He's been asking to talk to whoever broke that pen. I'd rather spit on him. But talk to him.

quests.title: The Young Captain
quests.offer:
You broke the pen. Good. I mean that.

I was a captain on the march. The Grand Inquisitor has decided the touched are the Glimmer's lamps - which they are - and so the Healers' Valley must burn, with every madman in it, and the healers too if they won't leave. The pitch-carts are already on the ridge road. I said no. That's why I'm here.

Will you [stop the carts]? I'll tell you where they are. I can't go myself - nobody here would let me, and they'd be right.
quests.summary: Ailill of the Azure says the Grand Inquisitor means to burn the Healers' Valley, touched folk and all.

steps.goal: Kill the Azure banishers with the pitch-carts on the ridge road about 540 m north-east of Ailill of the Azure
Search the pitch-carts

clue.name: an order in the Grand Inquisitor's hand

steps.text: 'Burn the valley from the ridge down. Then the Muster's camp, with whatever is in it. The Glimmer will have no lamps, and the south no friends of the fae. - the Grand Inquisitor.'

steps.goal: Bring the order to Ailill
steps.say:
"The Muster's camp, with whatever is in it." He'd have burned me with you.

Listen. The Order is wrong. I know that now. But the Glimmer King is still the enemy, and he's still in his ring. When the Muster takes the march and the Inquisitor falls - and he will fall to you - I'll gather whoever will follow me. Not the Order. Just the ones who came here to fight the Glimmer and still want to. When you go for the King, we go with you.

quests.title: The Inquisitor's Captains
quests.offer:
GROUP work. Ailill says the Inquisitor's three captains - Dsaldor, Coseal and Thror - are the ones who light the pyres. Without them the Order can only preach.

They hold the march with the Inquisitor. Will you [break the captains]? Bring friends. Lots of friends.
quests.summary: GROUP. The Grand Inquisitor's three captains, Dsaldor, Coseal and Thror, light the Azure's pyres.

steps.goal: Defeat Azure Dsaldor on the march about 740 m north-east of Elder Cnoc
Defeat Azure Thror
Defeat Azure Coseal
steps.text: Coseal falls among his censers. 'Ailill,' he says. 'Ailill told you. Tell the boy - the Inquisitor will burn him first.'

steps.goal: Report to Elder Cnoc
steps.say:
Three pyre-lighters gone. The lurikeen of the north will sleep tonight.

The Inquisitor's still on the march, with his pyres. That's for the whole Muster - the captains will call for it. And when he falls, I suppose Ailill gets his chance. ...I hope he takes it.

quests.title: The Lords of the West
quests.offer:
The Glimmer's host has lords - ten of them, named, each holding a stronghold. Kill the lord and the host there falls apart. I've seen it twice now.

Orist holds the valley just north of this camp, and Mianed holds the upland. Will you [hunt the lords]? I want whatever they carry.
quests.summary: Sentinel-Captain Maeve wants the Glimmer lords Orist and Mianed dead.

steps.goal: Defeat Glimmer Orist in the valley about 250 m north of Sentinel-Captain Maeve
Defeat Glimmer Mianed on the upland
steps.text: Mianed comes apart into light. Where he stood, a slate of glimmer-glass, scratched with names.

steps.goal: Bring the slate to Sentinel-Captain Maeve
steps.say:
Names. Not glimmer names - ours. 'Gearoid Iarla. Rider of the third rank.' 'Gearoid Iarla. Spear of the north shore.' It's a roll. The Earl's sleeping army, under Lough Gur.

That's what the silver shoes were for. The King wanted the Earl's host - for this war, for these hills. The Glimmer lords were to lead it.

quests.title: The Lords of the Valleys
quests.offer:
GROUP work. Three lords hold the west of the middle valleys together - Kelegur, Zeit and Meldun - close enough to come to each other's aid. They were to be the Earl's captains.

Will you [take the three]? Together, or they'll take you.
quests.summary: GROUP. The Glimmer lords Kelegur, Zeit and Meldun hold the west of the middle valleys together.

steps.goal: Defeat Glimmer Kelegur about 450 m north-east of Sentinel-Captain Maeve
Defeat Glimmer Zeit
Defeat Glimmer Meldun
Report to Sentinel-Captain Maeve
steps.say:
Three captains with no army to lead. The Earl sleeps on, under his lake - and I'll ride round it myself every seventh year and count his horseshoes if I have to.

Two more lords in the middle valleys, Arios and Xaquira. They're not captains. Ceallach says they're keepers - of what, he won't say till he's sure.

quests.title: The Keepers of the Lamps
quests.offer:
Arios and Xaquira. The middle valleys' last two lords. They don't fight like the others - they hang back, and the lights gather round them. I think they keep the King's lamps: the touched folk the Glimmer has burned. Every light in these hills.

Will you [put out the keepers]? If I'm right, the hills will be darker for it.
quests.summary: Druid Ceallach thinks the Glimmer lords Arios and Xaquira keep the King's lamps.

steps.goal: Defeat Glimmer Xaquira about 600 m east of Druid Ceallach
Defeat Glimmer Arios
steps.text: Arios goes out like a candle, and for a breath the whole valley around him goes dark - then the lights come back, but fewer.

steps.goal: Report to Druid Ceallach
steps.say:
Fewer. You saw it. Fewer lights.

The lights aren't the King. They're the King's - and they can be taken from him. But the last of them gather in his son's hollow, and the hollow's door is kept by Venlar, in the east. Maeve has the Sentinels ready for that one.

quests.title: The Gate-Keeper
quests.offer:
GROUP work, the hardest yet. Venlar holds the East Valley for the King - his guard-lord, the one who keeps the way to the Prince's Hollow. Deathwatchers and geists all round him, and knights.

Will you [go for Venlar]? Bring everyone. The Sentinels will be at your back.
quests.summary: GROUP. Glimmer Venlar, the King's guard-lord, holds the East Valley and the way to the Prince's Hollow.

steps.goal: Go up the East Valley about 1.4 km east of Sentinel-Captain Maeve
steps.text: The East Valley is one long glow. Everything in it is watching you.

steps.goal: Defeat Glimmer Venlar
steps.text: Venlar drops to one knee, burning out. 'The Prince waits,' he says. 'He was told you'd come. He has a letter for you.'

steps.goal: Report to Sentinel-Captain Maeve
steps.say:
A letter. For us? ...No. Not for us. Ceallach thinks he knows what it is. He's gone very quiet.

Ten lords. I've lost count of the Sentinels it took to follow the lights this far. Thank you.

quests.title: The King's Answer
quests.offer:
In Lough Gur we took a letter off the Unseelie envoy: 'The north for me, the south for you, and Lug between us.' Cliodna, writing to the Glimmer King. The envoy waited on the moor for the King's answer - and it never came, because we killed the herald who carried it.

The King would have written it again, and sent it by a surer hand. His son's. Venlar says the Prince has a letter. Will you [find the answer]? Zanllvi guards the road to the hollow.
quests.summary: Druid Ceallach thinks the Glimmer King's answer to Cliodna's letter lies in the Prince's Hollow.

steps.goal: Defeat Glimmer Zanllvi on the road to the hollow about 620 m south-east of Druid Ceallach
Search the Prince's Hollow

clue.name: a letter sealed in gold wax

steps.text: 'To the Queen in the north, from the King in the south. Agreed: the north for you, the south for me, and Lug between us. But hear this. Your goborchend dig in your forest for the Eye, and I will not share Ireland with Balor's kind. When Lug falls, shut the Eye - or I will shut it, and you with it. My son carries this, and my son does not lose letters. - C.'

steps.goal: Bring the King's answer to Druid Ceallach
steps.say:
'Lug between us.' The whole year - the mines, the revels, the wind, the fog, the lights on the lake, the tower in the bog - one bargain. Two kings of the sidhe carving Ireland in half, and our King in the middle.

And 'the Eye'. The Fomorian eye the goborchend were waking in the Cursed Forest. Cliodna was digging it up - and even the Glimmer King was afraid of it.

One more lord stands at the King's ring. Then we know where we are.

quests.title: The Ring of Stones
quests.offer:
GROUP work - and as hard as anything short of the King himself.

Saumer. The oldest of the lords, and the strongest. He waits at the western edge of the King's ring, in the south. With him dead, there's nothing left between the Muster and the King but the King.

Will you [face Saumer]? Bring every friend you have.
quests.summary: GROUP. Glimmer Saumer, the oldest of the Glimmer lords, guards the edge of the King's ring.

steps.goal: Defeat Glimmer Saumer by the King's ring about 930 m south-east of Sentinel-Captain Maeve
steps.text: Saumer falls, and for a moment, far off to the east among the stones, something enormous lifts its head and looks your way.

steps.goal: Report to Sentinel-Captain Maeve
steps.say:
He looked at you? He looked at you. Gods.

The Muster's ready. Ceallach wants to talk to you first - he's decided something about that letter.

quests.title: The Broken Bargain
quests.offer:
Here's where we are.

Cliodna's north is broken - the King's Host holds her forest when it marches, and she has to rebuild herself every time. The Glimmer King's south is breaking - his lords are dead, and the Muster can take his son's hollow and open his ring. The bargain is over. Neither of them has half of anything.

But the letter. 'The Eye.' Something both of them feared enough to put in writing. What we do with the letter matters. Will you [hear me out]?
quests.summary: The bargain between the Unseelie Queen and the Glimmer King is broken - but the King's letter names the Fomorian Eye.

steps.goal: Walk with Druid Ceallach down the valley, away from the camp about 180 m south-east of Druid Ceallach
steps.text: The valley is darker than it was. Behind you, in the camp, someone is singing - Lochlann's four notes, with a fifth at the end.

steps.goal: Decide what becomes of the King's answer
steps.say:
Two choices, and I can't make this one.

We [send it to Tara]. The King should know what was bargained over his head - and the druids of Tara should know that something under the Cursed Forest frightens dragons. They'll watch for it. Maybe too late; maybe not.

Or we [burn it]. Here, tonight. Nobody learns there's an Eye, nobody goes digging for it out of greed or curiosity, and maybe it sleeps another thousand years. Maybe.

options.say:
Then a rider leaves tonight. The King will read it, and the druids will watch the north. Whatever wakes there, it won't wake unseen.

The threat in the south is ended - for now. Go and finish it: the Muster's going for the hollow, and then the ring. Whatever comes after, it comes after.

...There. Gold wax burns blue. Did you know that? Nobody will ever read it again.

The threat in the south is ended - for now. Go and finish it: the Muster's going for the hollow, and then the ring. And if something ever opens its eye in that forest, we'll be the only two in Ireland who aren't surprised.
